title: Intranet Web Application

verification.live_browser_check: both routes executed against a running waitress server with zero external resource requests, Fn panel and classification views confirmed

delivered: self-contained Flask application factory under hydride_segmentation/web/
browser workspace with upload, drag-and-drop, and bundled example images
conventional and trained-model routes sharing the desktop and CLI registry
radial hydride fraction (Fn) reported length-weighted and count-based for both routes
user-controlled Fn angle threshold and minimum feature size, recorded in the manifest
opt-in Fn classification and angle-threshold QA views
grouped measurements with Fn first, plus JSON export of all metrics and settings
per-parameter in-app help plus a dedicated help page with an Fn explainer
result tabs, measurements table, and PNG downloads
startup model preloading on a background thread
bounded job pool with an explicit busy response
upload size caps, extension checks, content checks, and downscaling
waitress launcher printing intranet URLs, with a development fallback
systemd unit and Windows batch launcher for run-as-a-service
YAML configuration with environment and command-line overrides
offline wheelhouse install instructions for air-gapped hosts

performance.component_orientation_scan: 39x to 152x faster, sizes identical and angles within 2.6e-13 degrees
performance.fn_classification_render: MemoryError -> 0.64s on a 1386-feature mask; also fixes the desktop result-export path

remaining_gaps: no authentication; assumes a trusted intranet or a reverse proxy
browser lengths and areas are in pixels, not calibrated physical units; Fn itself is dimensionless
Fn inherits any segmentation error, so the overlay and Fn classification view remain the check
no batch upload in the browser
corrections and annotation editing remain desktop-only
analysis figures are always computed rather than requested on demand
